title: Home office deduction: simplified vs regular method
label: Gig worker money tip

hook.sub: Two IRS methods. You pick each year.

beats.sub: Not shared with family or guests.

cta.sub: We'll DM you our home office calculator.

captions.instagram:
Working from home? The IRS gives you two ways to figure the home office deduction.

✔️ Simplified: $5 per square foot, up to 300 sq ft, so $1,500 at most. No depreciation to track.
✔️ Regular: your actual home costs times the business-use percentage. More records, and it can come out higher.
✔️ Either way, the space must be used regularly and only for business.
✔️ You can choose the method each year on your original return.

Run both with our home office deduction calculator.
